The [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]] '''DEMP Ion Pistol''' was designed as a infantry support weapon for the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]]. It is the predecessor to the more known [[Destructive Electromagnetic Pulse 2 ion carbine|DEMP 2]] which built on the same principles.

The DEMP gun had three different power settings: The first setting only jolted a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] for a short time. The second could put a droid out of commission for a while with almost the same effect as a stun bolt would have to a Human. The third setting was designed to stop heavily armored droids and would completely short out not just the [[Power cell/Legends|power cell]], but fry the motivator and memory if used on a droid without heavy armor or insulation.

A [[DEMP Ion Carbine/Legends|larger]] version was also available in carbine form.
